response.justification: While the candidate exceeds the minimum 15-year experience requirement with 20 years of solid software engineering and demonstrates strong technical leadership, there are critical gaps for this specialized AI strategy role. The position requires a Director-level individual contributor with recognized AI expertise and demonstrated AI-powered products/platforms, but the candidate's AI experience is very recent (16 months at re:cinq in infrastructure tooling) and insufficient to establish the deep specialization this strategic role demands. Career progression shows Staff/Senior roles rather than Director level, and there is no advanced degree in AI/ML.
strengths: Exceeds minimum experience requirement with 20 years of diverse software engineering across web, mobile, desktop, embedded systems, and infrastructure
Demonstrated technical leadership through Staff roles, open-source project founding (GISCollective), and mentoring via technical workshops and courses
Current work on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP (Model Context Protocol) code generators at re:cinq shows active engagement with modern AI technologies
concerns: AI expertise is very recent (approximately 16 months), lacking the 'recognized expertise' and 'demonstrated products/platforms built with AI' specified as preferred qualifications
Career trajectory shows Staff/Senior level positions; role requires Director-level individual contributor status for strategic advisory responsibilities
No Master's or PhD in AI/ML field; limited deep specialization in AI/ML despite this being preferred and central to the role
